dedupe_keys.name: a benchmark dataset for class wise segmentation of construction and demolition waste in cluttered environments

description: A benchmark dataset for class-wise segmentation of construction and demolition waste in cluttered environments is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Diani Sirimewan et al. Efficient management of construction and demolition waste (CDW) can improve resource recovery. The lack of publicly available, high-quality datasets for waste recognition limits the development and adoption of automated waste handling solutions. To facilitate data sharing and reuse, this study introduces ‘CDW-Seg’, a benchmark dataset for class-wise segmentation of CDW. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: JSON, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 4573033627 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
